name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Shashak. His mention is brief and specific, with no additional notes to elaborate on his role or significance beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Hananiah means 'YHWH is gracious.' This proper name reflects a common biblical theme of God's grace, though there is no indication that the name was given directly by God in this instance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Hananiah as the son of Shashak. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hananiah's importance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin. Being identified as the son of Shashak situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribal families, serving as a link in the lineage that preserves the heritage and identity of God's people.
